decisions.reason: Changing the subject field's help text does not alter the requirement to preserve title-field formatting.
The source specifies help text but does not change how placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The subject help-text wording does not resolve or change the required visual cue mechanism for fillable fields.
The source changes field-specific help wording, not the mechanism used to provide robust standard text placeholders.
The specified subject help text does not change the checklist control type or behavior.
The specified subject help text does not change the Bestyrelsesmode dropdown control or its behavior.
Although the client distinguishes the date text from the subject text, the calendar-style date input method remains unchanged.
The subject field's help text has no effect on the required theme color palette.
The help-text change does not alter automatic bullet continuation when Enter is pressed.
The subject field's help wording is unrelated to bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or level variants.
The help-text change does not affect manual line-break entry after legacy content is pasted.
The Danish subject help text is field content, not a change to style names, prefixes, categories, or naming language.
